text:
Alejandro: Heads-up: I'm prepping the 40B variant (commit d3f9ac2) for staging. Quick checklist: where are the weights, any tokenizer special-token gotchas, RoPE scaling adjustments we should apply, and do we need to force GQA vs MQA? Any blockers?

Nina: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/40b/v1/{shard_000..015}.tar.gz — devon already verified the shards + checksum. One thing: tokenizer.vocab_size is 50260 on this export vs our expected 50257.

Devon: confirmed. sha256: abc123def... I added a manifest at repo:/manifests/40b-v1.json with weight paths. The extra 3 tokens are conversion control tokens (conversion-tool added them).

Sarah: Those 3 control tokens shift embedding indices and cause off-by-N in some evals. Two options: (1) add `disable_special_token_mapping: true` to the model runtime config, or (2) apply my tokenizer-adjust patch to the model tar (I linked the patch in the manifest).

Sanjay: For RoPE scaling: this export was converted with rope_scale=1.03 to support 4096 context. Runtime expects an explicit scaling policy. Example config snippet we use: 
```
"rope_scaling": {
  "type": "linear",
  "base_seq_len": 2048,
  "factor": 2.0
}
```
That tells the runtime how to rescale cached rotary embeddings across lengths.

Maria: Quick Q — is the runtime auto-converting MQA->GQA for this model or do we need to force a mode? We saw flakiness in long-context batches when multiple streams hit the same backend.

runtime-ci: compat-smoke: tokenization: WARN(shifted_vocab_indices), rope-sanity: PASS, gqa-detect: FAIL (batching edge case). Full logs: http://ci.internal/1234 (artifact attached).

Devon: The gqa fail is due to sliding-window stride != kv_chunk_size in our batching path. I opened PR #789 which sets `sliding_window.stride = kv_chunk_size - 8` for this model family; that aligns chunk boundaries with KV flushes and reduces cross-stream interference.

Alejandro: Can we run a 5% canary with the sliding-window stride patch + tokenizer mapping flag? Maria — can you own monitoring and rollback criteria?

Maria: Yup. I'll enable model.trace and add the eval set `long-dialogue-regen` to the canary suite. Alert conditions: latency p95 increase > 8% OR top-k logit drift > 0.02 (compared to baseline).

Sanjay: Also FYI: add `disable_auto_mqa: true` if you want to force GQA behavior even when the runtime detects multi-query patterns. Otherwise runtime will auto-convert based on observed batch patterns.

Alejandro: Thanks — I'll patch the manifest with `disable_special_token_mapping` and `rope_scaling` and start a 5% canary at ~15:10. Ping here when deployment kicks off :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started by Alejandro for model=40b-v1 canary at 1758123720 — rollout: 5%

runtime-ci: canary smoke at 1758123910: tokenization OK (mapping applied), latency +3% (within SLO), gqa-batching stable after stride patch. No immediate regressions. Closing the loopback.

Alejandro: Nice — leaving the canary running for 30m, will widen to 25% if no alerts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
